verses.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Palavra vista por Isaías, filho de Amoz, quanto a Judá e a Jerusalém:
verses.en_web: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: The word which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw about Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.pt: E acontecerá no últimos dias, que o monte da cada do SENHOR se firmará no cume dos montes, e se levantará por cima dos morros; e correrão em direção a ele todas as nações.
verses.en_web: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord will be placed on the top of the mountains, and be lifted up over the hills; and all nations will come to it.

verses.en: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E muitos povos irão, e dirão: Vinde, subamos ao monte do SENHOR, à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que ele nos ensine sobre seus caminhos, e andemos em suas veredas; Porque de Sião virá a Lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go out, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And the peoples will say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob: and he will give us knowledge of his ways, and we will be guided by his word; for out of Zion the law will go out, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.pt: E ele julgará entre as nações, e repreenderá a muitos povos; e trocarão suas espadas em enxadas, e suas lanças em foices; não se levantará mais espada nação contra nação, nem aprenderão mais a fazer guerra.
verses.en_web: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.en_bbe: And he will be the judge between the nations, and the peoples will be ruled by his decisions: and their swords will be turned into plough-blades, and their spears into vine-knives: no longer will the nations be turning their swords against one another, and the knowledge of war will be gone for ever.

verses.en: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.pt: Casa de Jacó, vinde, e andemos à luz do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: O family of Jacob, come, and let us go in the light of the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.pt: Mas tu, SENHOR, desamparaste a teu povo, à casa de Jacó; porque se encheram dos costumes do oriente, e são místicos como os filisteus; e se associam a filhos de estrangeiros.
verses.en_web: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O Lord, have given up your people, the family of Jacob, because they are full of the evil ways of the east, and make use of secret arts like the Philistines, and are friends with the children of strange countries.

verses.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.pt: A terra deles está cheia de prata e de ouro, e os tesouros deles não têm fim; a terra deles está cheia de cavalos, e as carruagens deles não têm fim.
verses.en_web: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
verses.en_bbe: And their land is full of silver and gold, and there is no end to their stores; their land is full of horses, and there is no end to their carriages.

verses.en: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.pt: A terra deles também está cheia de ídolos; eles se inclinam perante as obras de suas próprias mãos, perante o que seus próprios dedos fizeram.
verses.en_web: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
verses.en_bbe: Their land is full of images; they give worship to the work of their hands, even to that which their fingers have made.

verses.en: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.pt: Ali as pessoas se abatem, e os homens se humilham; por isso tu não os perdoarás.
verses.en_web: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
verses.en_bbe: And the poor man's head is bent, and the great man goes down on his face: for this cause there will be no forgiveness for their sin.

verses.en: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.pt: Entra nas rochas, e esconde-te no pó, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e da glória de sua majestade.
verses.en_web: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
verses.en_bbe: Go into a hole in the rock, covering yourselves with dust, in fear of the Lord, before the glory of his power.

verses.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.pt: Os olhos arrogantes dos homens serão abatidos, e o orgulho dos homens será humilhado; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.
verses.en_web: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.en_bbe: The high looks of man will be put to shame, and the pride of men will be made low, and only the Lord will be lifted up in that day.

verses.en: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.pt: Porque o dia do SENHOR dos exércitos será contra o soberbo e o arrogante; e contra todo de que se acha exaltado, para que seja abatido.
verses.en_web: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:
verses.en_bbe: For the day of the Lord of armies is coming on all the pride of men, and on all who are high and lifted up;

verses.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.pt: E contra todos os cedros do Líbano, altos e elevados; e contra todos os carvalhos de Basã.
verses.en_web: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.en_bbe: And on all the high trees of Lebanon, and on all the strong trees of Bashan;

verses.en: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.pt: E contra todos os altos montes, e contra todos os morros elevados.
verses.en_web: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.en_bbe: And on all the high mountains, and on all the hills which are lifted up;

verses.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.pt: E contra toda torre alta, e contra todo muro fortificado.
verses.en_web: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
verses.en_bbe: And on every high tower, and on every strong wall;

verses.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.pt: E contra todos os navios de Társis, e contra todas as pinturas desejadas.
verses.en_web: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
verses.en_bbe: And on all the ships of Tarshish, and on all the fair boats.

verses.en: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.pt: E a soberba do homem será humilhada, e o orgulho dos homens será abatido; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.
verses.en_web: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.en_bbe: And the high looks of man will be put to shame, and the pride of men will be made low: and only the Lord will be lifted up in that day.

verses.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.pt: E todos os ídolos serão eliminados por completo.
verses.en_web: The idols shall utterly pass away.
verses.en_bbe: And the images will never be seen again.

verses.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.pt: Então entrarão nas cavernas das rochas, e nos buracos da terra, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar, para espantar a terra.
verses.en_web: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.en_bbe: And men will go into cracks of the rocks, and into holes of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and before the glory of his power, when he comes out of his place, shaking the earth with his strength.

verses.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.pt: Naquele dia, o homem lançará seus ídolos de prata, e seus ídolos de ouro, que fizeram para se prostrarem diante deles, às toupeiras e aos morcegos.
verses.en_web: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.en_bbe: In that day men will put their images of silver and of gold, which they made for worship, in the keeping of the beasts of the dark places;

verses.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.pt: E se porão nas fendas das rochas, e nas cavernas das penhas, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa da glória de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar para espantar a terra.
verses.en_web: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.en_bbe: To take cover in the cracks of the rocks, and in the holes of the hills, for fear of the Lord, and before the glory of his power, when he comes out of his place, shaking the earth with his strength.

verses.en: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.pt: Portanto, cessai de confiar no homem, cujo fôlego está em suas narinas; pois o que há nele que mereça se dar algum valor?
verses.en_web: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
verses.en_bbe: Have no more to do with man, whose life is only a breath, for he is of no value.
